Requisitos

O que esperamos de você no dia a dia – conforme a área de atuação:

• Análise e desenvolvimento de sistemas

Sistemas operacionais de código aberto e código fechado; noções de ambiente de nuvem multicloud; programação estruturada e orientada a objetos; domínio sobre a utilização de aplicativos de escritório; estrutura de dados; padrões de projeto de software; desenvolvimento Web Front End; desenvolvimento Web Back End; desenvolvimento ágil de software; testes e inspeção de software; conhecimentos básicos em UI/UX; conhecimentos em microserviços; conhecimentos em IA, aprendizado de máquina (LLM) e serviços de IA em nuvem ou similares.

• Cibersegurança

Nível II: implementação e administração de firewall; conhecimento em multicloud; inteligência artificial aplicada à segurança da informação; gerenciamento estratégico de riscos e ameaças; tecnologias e práticas em cibersegurança; técnicas Red Team x Blue Team; conhecimento em Linux avançado; ferramentas de testes e de vulnerabilidades (pentest) externas e internas; ferramentas de penetration testing em aplicações Web, redes e ambiente interno; operações em plataformas SOAR e SIEM; conhecimento em ISO 27001/27002; LGPD.

Adicionais ao Nível III: governança de segurança corporativa, gestão de crises e estratégias de comunicação, ética e aspectos jurídicos em cibersegurança, segurança em ambientes industriais, projeto (PMO) para o desenvolvimento e apoio em projetos de segurança da informação com foco em tecnologia de ponta, conhecimento em ferramentas ofensivas.

Desejável: Certificações LPI (Linux), CompTIA Security, Fortinet, Cisco, EXIN

• Computação em Nuvem

Nível II: normas técnicas pertinentes à área de atuação; conhecimentos de Cloud (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS); estrutura global do serviço de nuvem; conhecimentos de Web Services; conectividade e ambientes computacionais com diversos tipos de aplicação; noções de redes LAN e WAN; conhecimento em linguagem de programação — desejável.

Adicionais ao Nível III: migração de ambientes on premise para nuvem; CI/CD; orquestração de fluxo de trabalho; conteinerização; conhecimento em programação para infraestrutura como código; monitoramento de infraestrutura e serviços em nuvem.

Desejáveis certificações AWS, Azure, Google, Oracle, CISCO, ou CompTIA.

• Desenvolvimento de jogos digitais e gamificação

Produção de jogos digitais com engines de desenvolvimento; build para diferentes plataformas, publicação em lojas; level design, gamificação, documentação técnica, modelagem 3D, áudio, roteiro, cinematics e game flow; desenvolvimento ágil, programação, testes, UI/UX, estruturas de dados e padrões de software; nuvem multicloud.

• Desenvolvimento mobile

Sistemas operacionais de código aberto e fechado; multicloud; programação orientada a objetos; APIs; desenvolvimento nativo Android/iOS; desenvolvimento mobile híbrido e multiplataforma; publicação em lojas; IA em nuvem.

Desejável: frameworks atuais como Flutter, React Native, Android SDK, SwiftUI ou similares.

• Design digital

Desenho de interfaces para Web; revisão de design; uso de ferramentas de gestão de projetos e versionamento; HTML semântico; CSS (pré-processadores); JavaScript; usabilidade, UX e UI; desenho de procedimentos de trabalho; vetorização, prototipagem, edição; IA como ferramenta de apoio; criação de briefs; layout conforme especificação; pesquisa de usabilidade.

• Gestão de big data / Ciência de dados

Conhecimentos em Python ou R; Linux/Windows; SQL/NoSQL; Process mining; processamento batch/streaming; Data warehouse (Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, etc.); Data Lake; Machine Learning; visualização (Seaborn, Matplotlib, Plotly); Power BI, Tableau; estatística.

• Informática básica

Nível II: Linux/Windows; montagem e manutenção de hardware; redes locais; cabeamento; nuvem multicloud; low-code web pages; escritório; planilhas e dashboards.

Adicionais ao Nível III: lógica de programação, páginas web, versionamento, BI, IA.

Desejáveis: certificações AWS, Azure, Google, Oracle, Cisco ou CompTIA.

• Manutenção de hardware

Nível II: montagem/manutenção de hardware, troubleshooting, software de suporte, diagnóstico, backup e recuperação; conhecimentos de eletricidade e eletrônica.

Adicionais ao Nível III: Arduino/Raspberry Pi/ESP32, sensores, multicloud.

Desejáveis: certificações AWS, Azure, Google, Oracle, Cisco, ITIL, COBIT ou CompTIA.

• Mídias digitais

Planejamento e operação de mídias digitais; produção de conteúdo; textos; audiovisual; usabilidade, UX/UI; campanhas de mídia social; SEO; IA como apoio; briefings.

Desejáveis: certificações Adobe.

• Programação de banco de dados

Nível II: UML, bancos de dados relacionais/não relacionais, SGBD, integração de BI, SQL, IA/LLM em nuvem.

Adicionais ao Nível III: Data Warehouse, Data Lake, normalização de dados.

Desejáveis: certificações AWS, Azure, Google, Oracle, Cisco ou CompTIA.

• Projeto de infraestrutura de redes

Nível II: normas técnicas; eletricidade; redes; multicloud; aterramento; cabeamento; redes ópticas; segurança no trabalho.

Adicionais ao Nível III: firewalls, WiFi, IoT, data centers.

Desejáveis: certificações AWS, Azure, Google, Oracle, Cisco, ITIL, COBIT ou CompTIA.

• Redes de comunicação de dados

Nível II: normas técnicas; LAN/WAN; firewalls; multicloud; infraestrutura de redes; EPIs.

Adicionais ao Nível III: WAN (MPLS, QoS), QoS, segurança, ISO/IEC 27000, gestão de projetos; virtualização; IoT.

Desejáveis (Nível III): certificações AWS, Azure, Google, Oracle, Cisco, ITIL, COBIT ou CompTIA.

title: ANALISTA DE PROJETOS DE IA PLENO
description:
Somos a Sólides, a única empresa de tecnologia brasileira de Gestão Integrada de Pessoas com Inteligência Comportamental. Nossa plataforma é #completadeverdade, com soluções para RH e Departamento Pessoal, feitas para todos os negócios do país.

Em 2022, nossa história ganhou ainda mais força! Recebemos o maior investimento já feito em uma HR Tech na América Latina — R$ 530 milhões, liderado pelo fundo Warburg Pincus — e adquirimos o Tangerino. Em 2024, a compra da Folha de Pagamento Digital nos consolidou como a one stop shop das PMEs e a união com RHGestor reforçou nosso compromisso de tornar a gestão de pessoas estratégica acessível a todas as empresas. Hoje, com mais de 30 mil clientes e oito milhões de vidas impactadas, lideramos o setor de empresas de alto crescimento no Brasil.

Para chegarmos onde ninguém mais chegou, nossos valores são o nosso guia: somos corajosos para ser diferentes, fortes para alcançar resultados extraordinários, especialistas em pessoas e apaixonados pelos nossos clientes. Se você também é movido por sonhos, resultados e pessoas, vem que a Sólides é seu lugar!

Buscamos um analista de projetos de IA PL para nos ajudar nesta missão realizando a gestão e execução de projetos estratégicos de IA, atuando como ponto focal entre o time técnico e o negócio.

Suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Gestão de Board (Azure DevOps): Configurar, organizar e manter a higiene do board no Azure DevOps, usando corretamente Work Items (Epics, Features, Stories) e regras para refletir o WIP (Work In Progress).
  • Planejamento Estratégico: Liderar a definição de Sprint Goals com PO, time e Diretoria. Usar dados de Capacity/Velocity para firmar compromissos realistas e alinhados às prioridades.
  • Gestão de Dependências: Atuar como ponto focal para identificar e resolver bloqueios cross-team. Mapear dependências (Delivery Plans), negociar prazos e mitigar riscos de atraso.
  • Monitoramento/Inteligência de Dados: Desenvolver e manter Queries (WIQL) e Dashboards dinâmicos para monitorar métricas vitais (Burndown, Cycle/Lead Time). Traduzir dados em planos de ação para otimizar a eficiência do fluxo.
  • Facilitação/Alinhamento: Conduzir ritos (Planejamento, Refinamento). Garantir clareza dos requisitos (DoR) e atuar na remoção ativa de impedimentos.

Para esta posição, esperamos que você tenha:

  • Azure Boards: Experiência comprovada em configuração/administração de projetos no Azure DevOps (personalização de processos, backlogs hierárquicos, Kanban avançado).
  • Core Agile: Sólida vivência em Scrum e Kanban. Capacidade de facilitar rituais, gerir escopo e aplicar técnicas de estimativa/planejamento.
  • Gestão de Conflitos/Prazos: Experiência em ambientes Scaled Agile/Multi-Team. Habilidade de negociação para alinhar cronogramas e gerir expectativas de stakeholders.
  • Comunicação Analítica: Comunicar status de projeto baseado em dados, adaptando a linguagem entre o técnico e o negócio.

  • Relacionamento Interdepartamental: Colaborar estreitamente com outros departamentos para integrar estratégias de dados em toda a organização e garantir que as decisões sejam baseadas em insights precisos e relevantes.

description:
Company Description

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI‑enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud‑based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

Job Description

What you get to do in this role

We are seeking a highly experienced Technical Consultant in ServiceNow with a proven track record of delivering large‑scale enterprise implementations across Technology Workflows such as ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, SPM, Risk, SecOps and Core Business Workflows including HRSD, S2P, Workplace Service Delivery, Legal and others. This is a senior consultative role requiring both deep technical expertise and strong client‑facing skills. The ideal candidate acts as a trusted advisor, guiding clients through strategic roadmaps, adoption strategies and process improvements, while delivering scalable, maintainable ServiceNow solutions aligned with leading practices.

  • Lead the configuration, design and implementation of multiple ServiceNow modules with hands‑on technical expertise
  • Design and optimize solutions using JavaScript, Flow Designer, Playbooks, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, ACLs, Notifications, Knowledge Management, Service Portal, Employee Center and platform automation features
  • Drive large‑scale integrations with high data volumes, ensuring performance, security and maintainability
  • Apply best practices in platform governance, performance optimization and maintenance including upgrades and patching cycles
  • Act as a trusted advisor on adoption strategies, process improvements and alignment with ServiceNow leading practices
  • Lead workshops, define current and future state processes and ensure solutions achieve business outcomes
  • Oversee and validate development work from partners or customer teams, ensuring quality and adherence to technical standards
  • Collaborate across functions including BPCs, architects, project managers and business consultants to deliver high value outcomes
  • Mentor and coach junior consultants and contribute to organizational knowledge and leading practices
  • Drive strategic conversations with senior client stakeholders and serve as a thought leader in the industry

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision‑making, or problem‑solving, including using AI‑powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI‑driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
  • Advanced English and Spanish
  • Fifteen years of progressive experience in professional services or equivalent technical and consulting experience
  • Proven hands‑on experience in ServiceNow implementations across Technology and Core Business Workflows
  • Advanced development skills in JavaScript including scripting with Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, ACLs and customizations
  • Experience with Flow Designer, Playbooks, Knowledge Management, Service Portal, Employee Center and platform automation; strong experience with large data volume integrations using ServiceNow native and custom approaches
  • Solid knowledge of platform performance, governance, maintenance best practices and technical architecture
  • Deep expertise in at least three ServiceNow modules
  • Demonstrated experience driving adoption, client engagement and strategic roadmaps
  • Experience evaluating and leveraging AI‑powered workflows and automation for business outcomes
  • Nice to have ServiceNow certifications including CTA, CSA, CAD and two or more CIS certifications aligned to implemented workflows
  • Experience with platform upgrades, patching and technical maintenance
  • Knowledge of business processes related to ServiceNow modules
  • Industry experience in Financial Services, Telecommunications or Public Sector
  • Familiarity with architecture frameworks such as TOGAF or similar

Key Competencies And Soft Skills

Excellent written and verbal communication and executive presence; ability to manage complex client relationships and influence senior stakeholders; strong consultative and problem‑solving skills; creative, entrepreneurial and comfortable driving initiatives independently; experience working collaboratively across global teams; ability to travel up to fifty percent as required.

  • Semestralmente, os candidatos inscritos poderão ser convidados a responder novo formulário de triagem para atualização das informações.

Marketing Technology and Operations Manager

We are seeking a highly skilled Marketing Technology & Operations Manager for one of our clients. As such, you will have to lead their marketing technology stack, streamline automation processes, and enhance campaign execution. The ideal candidate has experience in marketing automation, CRM systems, and data analytics, with hands-on experience in Salesforce (SFDC) and HubSpot. In this role, you will be responsible for implementing, managing, and optimizing marketing systems to enhance eﬃciency and performance. Additionally, you will serve as the primary support resource during US hours, ensuring seamless operations for our global team.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize the marketing technology stack, ensuring seamless integration between tools as Salesforce, HubSpot, 6sense, WordPress, and other marketing automation platforms.
  • Own and manage relationships with external marketing technology vendors for lights-on support, serving as the primary point of contact for their Customer Success Managers during U.S. business hours while other team members are offline
  • Oversee marketing operations, including lead management, data hygiene, campaign execution, and reporting.
  • Develop and implement automation workflows to improve lead nurturing, scoring, and pipeline velocity.
  • Collaborate with sales, marketing, and RevOps teams to align technology and operations with business objectives.
  • Monitor and improve marketing performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Implement and enforce data governance best practices, ensuring compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and other regulations.
  • Evaluate new technologies and tools, making recommendations for improving efficiency and performance.

Requirements and Skills

  • 3-4+ years of experience in marketing technology and operations, preferably in a B2B environment.
  • Strong technical expertise in Salesforce (SFDC) and HubSpot
  • Experience with marketing automation, CRM integration, and data management.
  • Proficiency in reporting and analytics.
  • Strong data skills and proficiency with Google Sheets, formulas
  • Excellent problem-solving and project management skills with the ability to prioritize and execute multiple initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing, demand generation, and ABM strategies.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • ABM Platforms: Experience with 6sense, Terminus, Demandbase, or other account-based marketing (ABM) tools
  • SEO & Web Analytics: Knowledge of Google Tag Manager (GTM),
  • Advertising & Paid Media: Familiarity with Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and programmatic advertising platforms

The Company

Infogain is a digital platform engineering firm based in Silicon Valley. We engineer business outcomes for Fortune 500 companies and digital natives in the technology, healthcare, insurance, travel, telecom, and retail/CPG industries. We accelerate experience-based transformation in the delivery of digital platforms using technologies such as cloud, microservices, automation, IoT, and artificial intelligence. Infogain is a multi-cloud expert in hyper-scale cloud providers: Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, and Amazon Web Services.

Infogain, an Apax Fund's portfolio company, has offices in California, Washington, Texas, the United Kingdom, the United Arab Emirates, and Singapore, with delivery centers in Seattle, Houston, Austin, Montevideo, Krakow, Noida, Bangalore, Pune, Gurgaon, and Mumbai.

Infogain is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, or age.

A Stellantis é uma das principais montadoras e fornecedoras de mobilidade do mundo, oferecendo soluções de mobilidade limpas, conectadas, acessíveis e seguras. A força da nossa empresa está na amplitude do nosso portfólio de marcas icônicas, na diversidade e paixão das nossas pessoas e nas raízes profundas que temos nas comunidades onde atuamos. Nossas estratégias ambiciosas de eletrificação e software, juntamente com a criação de um ecossistema inovador de parcerias estratégicas e transformadoras, estão impulsionando nossa transformação em uma empresa de tecnologia de mobilidade sustentável.

A força motriz por trás de tudo isso é o grupo diverso e talentoso de homens e mulheres ao redor do mundo, que trazem sua paixão e experiência para o trabalho todos os dias. E, embora sejamos uma organização verdadeiramente global, permanecemos profundamente conectados às comunidades onde operamos e onde nossos colaboradores vivem e trabalham. Com operações industriais em quase 30 países, a Stellantis consegue atender consistentemente às necessidades e expectativas em constante evolução dos consumidores em mais de 130 mercados, ao mesmo tempo em que gera valor superior para todas as partes interessadas.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Engenheiro(a) Sênior Líder de Projetos para atuar na liderança e coordenação dos Engenheiros Responsáveis de Projeto (DRE) e dos projetistas para as entregas relacionadas às atividades de design e release de novos suportes (adaptation brackets) em sistemas de propulsão para os carros desenvolvidos no Brasil. Essa posição é estratégica para garantir excelência técnica, inovação e alinhamento global, promovendo soluções robustas, inovadoras e com melhor custo-benefício para a empresa. O maior desafio da posição é integrar e alinhar de forma eficaz as expectativas de todas as partes interessadas, a fim de entregar soluções técnicas robustas respeitando os requisitos e restrições de projeto.

  • Apoiar e incentivar atividades de teardown e benchmarking;
  • Incentivar e promover a geração de patentes como resultado de inovações no produto;
  • Desenvolver e apoiar tecnicamente os engenheiros de produto na equipe;
  • Assegurar a aplicação consistente das ferramentas DFMEA, GD&T e APQP ao longo do processo de desenvolvimento;
  • Assegurar a evolução técnica e a aprovação dos testes relacionados;
  • Contribuir tecnicamente em atividades de diagnóstico;
  • Fornecer informações técnicas e suporte à manufatura em colaboração com os engenheiros de produto;
  • Garantir conformidade técnica com os padrões internos e as melhores práticas de engenharia;
  • Capacitar e desenvolver os membros da equipe, incentivando o crescimento técnico;
  • Alinhar-se com equipes globais de engenharia nas regiões EMEA, América do Norte, América Latina e Ásia-Pacífico;
  • Guiar as equipes de projetistas e engenheiro de produto na entrega de soluções robustas, fabricáveis e com custo otimizado durante a criação de conceitos em 3D e construção dos desenhos 2D;
  • Fornecer suporte técnico às áreas de manufatura, qualidade e arquitetura veicular;
  • Garantir documentação coerente e rastreável no Plano de Controle de desenvolvimento, permitindo monitoramento e acompanhamento eficaz.

  • Inglês avançado (nível C1 mínimo);
  • Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas de qualidade e desenvolvimento de produto (DFMEA, GD&T, VSA, APQP);
  • Experiencia prévia comprovada em liderança de equipes de engenharia do produto no setor automotivo.

Diferenciais

  • Atuação prévia com equipes globais e fornecedores internacionais;

Fundada por Norberto Jaeger em 1946, a Companhia Minuano de Alimentos, surgiu como uma pequena fábrica de embalagens de papel e tipografia, mudando de ramo no ano de 1955, ingressando na avicultura.

Na década de 1970, tornou-se uma das maiores empresas produtoras de carnes de aves do Brasil, e participou da fundação da Associação Brasileira dos Produtores e Exportadores de Frangos (Abef), que se tornaria União Brasileira de Avicultura (Ubabef) em 2010, consolidando-se como uma referência para o setor a nível nacional.

Em 1984, a Minuano adquiriu uma fábrica de embutidos em Arroio do Meio, abastecida com matéria-prima das unidades de abate de aves de produtores integrados, e ampliando sua atuação dentro do segmento da alimentação.

Atualmente, a Minuano é uma operação verticalizada na integração avícola, possuindo desde granja de matrizes até produção e abate de aves, garantindo a qualidade em cada parte do processo. O parque industrial é composto por sete unidades, sendo elas o Abatedouro Frigorífico, Fábrica de embutidos, Incubatório, Granjas de Matrizes, Fábrica de Rações e Centro Administrativo.

Com as suas operações de aves voltadas à prestação de serviços para terceiros, a companhia se movimenta no sentido de produzir e entregar alimentos de qualidade, focando sua energia na operação de produção de embutidos, reafirmando a força da sua imagem e o reconhecimento junto ao consumidor. A Companhia exporta para mais de 30 países, em quatro continentes. No mercado interno, são quase 30 itens compondo o Mix, que podem ser encontrados em todo o estado do Rio Grande do Sul, reafirmando a relação da marca com o povo gaúcho.

Para potencializar o seu direcionamento, a empresa adota uma postura consultiva frente aos seus clientes, sejam eles internos ou externos, promovendo momentos de desenvolvimento.

Temos o certificado GPTW, pelo sexto ano consecutivo, e em 2024 entramos no Ranking das 175 Melhores para se Trabalhar da GPTW, o que reforça o nosso comprometimento em proporcionar uma excelente experiência também para os nossos colaboradores.

title: Oliver Wyman - Talent Manager - Sao Paulo
description:
Overview


Oliver Wyman is a global leader in management consulting. With offices in 70 cities across 30 countries, Oliver Wyman combines deep industry knowledge with specialized expertise in strategy, operations, risk management, and organization transformation. Our 7,000 professionals help clients optimize their business, improve their operations and risk profile, and accelerate their organizational performance to seize the most attractive opportunities. Oliver Wyman’s thought leadership is evident in our agenda-setting books, white papers, research reports, and articles in the business press. Our clients are the CEOs and executive teams of the top Global 1000 companies.


Visit our website for more details about Oliver Wyman:



Position Overview


Oliver Wyman is seeking a Talent Manager to manage a population of ~60 consultants across Oliver Wyman’s offices and Practices. This role will be responsible for their scheduling and performance management, and for personally engaging with the consultants in your group to know and understand their strengths, development objectives, personal preferences and career goals. You will also interact with Partners and Talent Managers in other parts of the business to assemble consulting teams and to remediate any issues.


The successful Talent Manager will be able to proactively, delicately and empathetically balance the needs of the business alongside the preferences, career goals and development needs of the consultant to deliver appropriate staffing and talent management outcomes. You will work in a tight knit team against demanding timelines to help deliver Oliver Wyman’s business model.


This is a hybrid role that requires 3 days per week in the office. There is no option to be fully remote.



Key Responsibilities


Talent Management:



  • Use the performance management process as a basis for engaging own consultants on development needs and areas for training

  • Develop relationships with each consultant and begin to be seen as a trusted advisor

  • Assist in directing consultants towards resources for career advice

  • Assist the consultants in escalating employee relations issues or questions around general Human Capital operations

  • Monitor for work-life-quality issues and escalate when needed

  • Collaborate with Human Capital Manager on managing the pyramid, training, onboarding, performance improvement initiatives


Project Staffing:



  • Understand at a high-level the nuances of the type of work / roles being filled

  • Liaise with project team leaders to understand staffing needs in your area

  • For assigned projects, collect all relevant details from Partners and Practice Group TMs on projects to be staffed

  • Anticipate capacity issues and manage consultants' and Partner expectations accordingly

  • Communicate staffing outcomes to consultants under your TM purview in an empathetic manner

  • Track mobility issues, holidays, trainings, background checks and other ad-hoc staffing enabling tasks

  • Ensure consultant files (bio slides, project reviews, technical skills, etc) are kept current and readily available for project proposals

  • Track your consultant’s performance, skills and development needs to help guide their growth and progression within OW


Consultant Development and Performance Management:



  • Understand the performance management framework and competency model and how it applies to own consultant's situations

  • Coordinate with the Learning and Development team on appropriate training for your consultants

  • Read all performance appraisals and follow-up any issues / performance flags with project team and manager

  • Coordinate, attend and contribute to annual Career Review meetings in for own consultant populations


Data, analysis and reporting:



  • Review weekly utilization reports, cross reference with the systems to ensure latest information is captured

  • Assist with the assembly of the project pipeline and consultant availability reports

  • Help to prepare documents and exhibits for various senior leadership meetings (using Excel and PowerPoint)

  • Assist with the analysis of performance outcome results

  • Ad hoc analyses and reporting as needed

  • Demonstrate capability in using enterprise resource management tools and performance systems

  • Maintain all employee records and keep resource planning systems up to date

  • Participate in project work within and adjacent to the broader Human Capital function on topics such as employee experience, retention, flexible working, utilization, performance, etc.

  • Organize own work and display ability to guide colleagues in building project deliverables

  • Work on cross-Practice Group, Market, Regional teams to deliver special / ad-hoc assignment in a collaborative manner

  • Be a firm citizen and embody Oliver Wyman values in day-to-day activities

  • Display a strong willingness to learn more about OW outside of the TM function by seeking out opportunities for broader involvement



Experience Required



  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience

  • 3-5 years of relevant professional experience in a fast-paced and dynamic client services business environment

  • Management consulting and/or Human Resources experience preferred



Skills and Attributes



  • Proven ability to establish and grow relationships at all levels within an organization

  • Credible, highly professional, able to communicate and negotiate effectively while managing diverse personalities, cultures and backgrounds

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to tailor the message to fit the audience

  • Self-motivated and proactive; someone who takes full ownership of her/his work and is flexible to prioritize or reprioritize as needed

  • Comfortable working with data (excel, powerpoint and enterprise resource management software)

  • Creative, strategic thinker who continually seeks ways to improve processes

  • Genuinely interested in the development and career success of the consultants with whom you work

  • A strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy is required to juggle multiple projects and tasks simultaneously; as well as the ability to organize, prioritize and manage one’s day and schedule to effectively to meet deadlines

  • Comfortable working independently, but can thrive in a team setting; all while working in a fast-paced environment

  • English and Spanish Speaker



Company and Diversity


Oliver Wyman, a business of Marsh McLennan (NYSE: MMC), is a management consulting firm combining deep industry knowledge with specialized expertise to help clients optimize their business, improve operations and accelerate performance. At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective human intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting‑edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double‑checks assumptions and plays devil’s advocate. Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

  • Analysts, researchers, or consultants with strong critical thinking skills
  • Students (senior undergrads / grad students) looking for an intellectually interesting gig
  • People open to a part‑time and non‑permanent opportunity

About the Project

We’re on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Throughout the project, you’ll have to balance quality assurance, research, and logical problem‑solving. This project opportunity is ideal for people who enjoy looking at systems holistically and thinking through scenarios, implications, and edge cases.

You do not need a coding background, but you must be curious, intellectually rigorous, and capable of evaluating the soundness and consistency of complex setups. If you’ve ever excelled in things like consulting, CHGK, Olympiads, case solving, or systems thinking — you might be a great fit.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Reviewing evaluation tasks and scenarios for logic, completeness, and realism
  • Identifying inconsistencies, missing assumptions, or unclear decision points
  • Helping define clear expected behaviors (gold standards) for AI agents
  • Annotating cause‑effect relationships, reasoning paths, and plausible alternatives
  • Thinking through complex systems and policies as a human would to ensure agents are tested properly
  • Working closely with QA, writers, or developers to suggest refinements or edge case coverage

How to Get Started

Apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to a project aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. Shape the future of AI while building tools that benefit everyone.

Requirements

  • Excellent analytical thinking: Can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications
  • Strong attention to detail: Can spot contradictions, ambiguities, and vague requirements
  • Familiarity with structured data formats: Can read, not necessarily write JSON/YAML
  • Ability to assess scenarios holistically: What’s missing, what’s unrealistic, what might break?
  • Good communication and clear writing (in English) to document your findings.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Ariox is an iPaas, or Integration Platform as a Service company. Our iPass solution is Lumino, which efficiently integrates, automates and connects all/any data from various day to day operating systems and applications. For example, an iPaaS can allow a user to connect their ERP, CRM, WMS, or TMS software to each other and share data that may have previously been sorted, moved or shared across systems manually by an employee or other resource. Traditionally, integrating data was a complex process that required equally complex custom solutions and in most cases, was cost prohibitive for the majority of enterprises. iPaaS works to democratize this data sharing and gives control of the integration process to the user themselves. Many implementations of Lumino can be done with lightning speed through the use of pre-built application connectors that make for a plug and play integration experience. Once application connectors are in place, users have the ability to configure those connections, whether that be altering data as it passes between systems, controlling the order of operations within an integration, or simply designating which data sets are part of a given integration.

Ariox is seeking a Full Stack Developer ready to work with new technologies and architecture in this forward-thinking organization that is constantly pushing boundaries. At Ariox, developers must be able to take complete, end-to-end ownership of projects across the entire stack, and be comfortable with both front and back-end programming. Successful candidates will be responsible for developing and designing front-end web architecture, ensuring the responsiveness of applications, coding using pre-established development frameworks and patterns, and utilizing third-party libraries. Ideal candidates will have experience building products across the stack and a firm understanding of web frameworks, APIs, databases, and multiple back-end languages. The successful candidate will be required to complete projects rapidly, and have strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Successful candidates will join a small AGILE team working at the forefront of new technology, solving challenges that impact both the front-end and back-end architecture, and ultimately, delivering unique global user experiences. This role is ideal for someone who is established as a developer and loves to learn new skills. This position will demand continuous improvement of skillsets and technical abilities.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Adhere to and be actively engaged in the established AGILE/ SCRUM process.
  • Responsible for reading and interpreting user stories and creating solution(s) that satisfy the requirements by producing readable and maintainable code using established coding patterns.
  • Provide on-going support for the entire developed product.
  • Create process flowcharts, diagrams, and other related documentation.
  • Engage in the acquisition of current job knowledge by studying new development tools, programming techniques, and computing equipment; participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal and professional networks; participating in professional organizations.
  • Participate actively in a hands-on team experience to be productive and make an impact on a daily basis.
  • Collaborate actively and fully with the software development team.

Experience

  • 2 - 3 years of full-stack development experience

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field
  • Understanding of SOLID principles and clean architecture
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
  • Have strong analytical skills and the ability to think outside the box
  • Be an excellent communicator, a team player, have a positive attitude, and a willingness to get things done
  • Possess an openness and eagerness to learn new technologies
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office suite of tools

The Academic Programme Leader is a key academic leadership role, responsible for shaping, directing, and inspiring excellence in the Advanced Diploma in Business Analysis programme. The role provides strategic oversight to ensure the programme remains innovative, industry-relevant, academically rigorous, and aligned with institutional quality and regulatory standards.

This position serves as a thought leader, mentor, and academic champion , driving curriculum excellence, student success, impactful teaching and learning strategies, and meaningful stakeholder engagement. You will influence the full lifecycle of the programme from design, development, and delivery, to review, enhancement, and continuous improvement.

This is an exciting opportunity for an academic professional who wants to lead a flagship programme , contribute to shaping future-ready Business Analysts, and strengthen academic scholarship and innovation in the school.

  • Provide visionary leadership aligned to the institution’s mission and academic strategy.

  • Lead the rollout, implementation, and growth of new and existing programmes.

  • Perform programme lifecycle management informed by data, benchmarking, industry needs and student outcomes.
  • Analyse student throughput, retention, success, articulation, and dropout trends and implement appropriate interventions.
  • Collaborate with academic services, support, and leadership teams to enhance student experience and performance.

Programme Planning & Academic Administration

  • Oversee onboarding and academic induction of programme staff.
  • Drive impactful student orientation and ongoing academic support initiatives.
  • Contribute to programme budget planning and resource allocation.
  • Support programme marketing, positioning, and value-proposition initiatives.
  • Oversee academic staffing needs for curriculum development, teaching, supervision, and assessment.
  • Ensure accuracy and quality of programme information across internal and external platforms.

Teaching, Learning & Student Success

  • Lead innovative teaching and learning approaches that promote student engagement.
  • Facilitate academic webinars, masterclasses, and thought leadership forums where required.
  • Oversee high-quality assessment practices including development, moderation, and grading.
  • Supervise postgraduate students and cultivate a strong culture of academic excellence.
  • Strengthen academic integrity, inclusivity, and continuous teaching and learning enhancement.

Programme Intelligence, Governance & Quality Assurance

  • Drive a data-informed culture of academic performance management and improvement.
  • Ensure adherence to institutional policies, SOPs, and regulatory frameworks.
  • Monitor and respond to regulatory conditions and recommendations.
  • Submit high-quality programme performance reports and strategic recommendations.
  • Lead programme and module reviews, re-alignment, and improvement initiatives.
  • Oversee WIL (Work-Integrated Learning) components (where applicable).

Stakeholder & Industry Engagement

  • Build and maintain relationships with academic, industry, alumni, and professional networks.
  • Promote opportunities for student employability, internships, and industry collaboration.
  • Collaborate with the Career Centre to provide programme-specific career advisory support.
  • Represent the programme at institutional committees, events, audits, and accreditation processes.

Community and Research Engagement

  • Promote and support community engagement activities aligned to programme focus areas.
  • Encourage faculty and student involvement in research, innovation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

Institutional Contribution & Leadership

  • Participate actively in institutional academic committees, events, and strategic initiatives.
  • Execute additional responsibilities or leadership tasks assigned by Faculty leadership.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Master’s Degree in Information Technology / Business Analysis / Information Systems or related field (NQF Level 9 preferred).
  • Minimum 3–5 years’ experience in Higher Education teaching and/or academic management.

Preferred/Advantageous

  • Experience in programme leadership and academic quality management.
  • Minimum 2 years’ experience with Learning Management System (LMS) administration/coordination.
  • Strong HE Academic Management background within an IT or Business Analysis environment.

SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES

We are seeking a dynamic academic leader who is:

  • Academically influential with strong subject-matter expertise.
  • Innovative, strategic, and committed to future-focused education.
  • Skilled in leadership, coaching, and academic staff mentorship.
  • Strong in problem-solving, analytics, curriculum design, and academic administration.
  • Digitally literate and comfortable with EdTech, LMS platforms, and digital pedagogy.

title: Senior Programme Officer, Business & Nature
description:
Senior Programme Officer, Business & Nature

Background

The International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) is a global Union of over 1,400 members, primarily government and civil society organizations, supported by more than 18,000 experts. Headquartered in Gland, Switzerland, with offices worldwide, IUCN is recognized as the leading authority on the status of nature and the actions needed to protect it.

As a trusted source of conservation data, analysis, and standards, IUCN provides a neutral platform where governments, NGOs, businesses, Indigenous peoples, and other stakeholders collaborate to advance sustainable development. Its global projects blend scientific innovation with local knowledge to restore ecosystems, halt habitat loss, and enhance human well‑being.

The Business & Nature Global Team drives the adoption of nature‑positive business practices by leveraging IUCN’s tools, metrics, and partnerships across corporate, sectoral, and regulatory levels. This work is delivered through collaborations with IUCN’s regional offices, members, and partners worldwide.

In South America, IUCN’s Regional Office (IUCN SUR) has operated from Quito, Ecuador, since 1992, with a National Office in Brasília, Brazil, since 2010. In Brazil, IUCN implements regional and global initiatives on protected areas, the Green List, Nature‑based Solutions, Forest Landscape Restoration, and other Nature 2030 priorities. Partners include federal and state agencies, academia, NGOs (24 members), and growing private‑sector collaborations. IUCN is also engaged in strategic collaborations with leading private sector actors and intends to expand this portfolio with this position.

This position is based in São Paulo, Brazil. The person will be contracted according to the Brazilian law (CLT), and it will include medical and life insurance.

Job Description

Overall Responsibility

The Senior Programme Officer in Business & Nature is responsible for the technical management, implementation and development of a portfolio of collaborative partnerships with companies and public actors in sectors in Brazil with important impacts on biodiversity (including but not limited to the metals and mining, aggregates, paper & pulp, chemicals industries, nature‑based industries and agrifood) to support the delivery of measurable Nature Positive outcomes aligned with IUCN Programme targets, whilst generating high quality knowledge and learning. In doing so, s/he will be expected to collaborate with the IUCN Business & Nature Global team, IUCN Regional Office for South America (IUCN SUR), the Brazilian Country Office, the Brazilian National Committee of IUCN members, IUCN thematic Teams, as well as with IUCN Commissions as necessary to ensure that recommendations and lessons learnt are integrated into the programmes policy and knowledge work.

Specific Responsibilities and Duties

Under the supervision of the Regional Programme Coordinator and close coordination of the Business and Nature Senior Programme Manager, the main duties and responsibilities include:

1. Portfolio technical implementation and development

  • Develop private sector use and application of IUCN standards, metrics, and tools, such as the IUCN RHINO approach (Rapid High‑Integrity Nature‑positive Outcomes), Species Threat Abatement and Restoration (STAR) metric, NbS Standard, and the Integrated Biodiversity Assessment Tool (IBAT) while promoting the application of the mitigation hierarchy and IUCN’s relevant policies in Brazil;
  • Collaborate with companies and sectoral bodies in Brazil to refine IUCN tools, providing technical feedback to IUCN global teams to strengthen knowledge and best practices on nature‑positive approaches, and increase their relevance and uptake in the business sector;
  • Explore ways to combine IUCN tools (e.g., STAR) with other approaches, such as Life Cycle Assessments, to enhance their relevance and use across sectors;
  • Facilitate Independent Scientific and Technical Advisory Panels in Brazil, providing strategic expertise to address complex and controversial issues and build trust amongst stakeholders;
  • Help identify opportunities and support the development of technical proposals to the private sector in Brazil, that use IUCN’s data, tools, and expertise to deliver Nature Positive results;
  • Develop concepts and funding proposals to donors for projects that strengthen enabling conditions—such as policies and regulations—supporting the sectoral transition toward Nature Positive outcomes;
  • Support the regional team in establishing and strengthening collaborations with the private sector in the region and in preparing high‑quality technical proposals.

2. Project portfolio management, delivery, and quality assurance

  • Provide technical assistance and capacity building to private sector partners, contributing to sectoral transformation and high‑quality project outcomes;
  • Ensure timely and effective delivery of projects and initiatives in line with annual workplans and IUCN standards;
  • Manage project resources—including financial, human, and intellectual—efficiently and adaptively, in accordance with IUCN project management guidelines;
  • Engage and oversee consultants and external project counterparts to maintain technical quality and support project delivery;
  • Lead coordination with internal teams, external partners, and IUCN units—including HQ, Regional, and Country Offices—to ensure smooth, joint implementation and delivery of projects;
  • Work with regional (and national) colleagues to ensure effective implementation of Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning frameworks for the business lines and project portfolio.
  • Manage project planning, budgeting, reporting, and documentation following IUCN’s tools and policies (e.g., Smartsheet, project portal, risk management);
  • Support the organization of workshops, meetings, and other events that strengthen project implementation and stakeholder engagement.

3. Capacity building, Knowledge generation and Communication

  • Ensure key results and lessons learnt are communicated in insightful knowledge products and promoted through various media channels and networks, to reach both external and internal audiences. Coordinate with national, regional and global communication focal points for this purpose.
  • Strengthen IUCN's capacity, influence and external visibility on work with the private sector, including by developing new training programmes to promote IUCN’s tools and approaches for the private sector and support their uptake (in collaboration with the IUCN Academy);
  • Participate in meetings, conferences, and platforms of relevance to the work program described above, to advance and showcase IUCN technical and thought leadership to drive sector‑wide transformation, and to influence and mobilize new networks, partners, and stakeholders.
  • Nurture working relationships with existing partners and establish new partnerships in Brazil and in the region, including resource mobilization.

4. Collaborative Work with IUCN SUR, Brazil Team and IUCN Business & Nature team

  • Participate in events and meetings, with a special focus on (but not limited to) strengthening relationships with the private sector, while also engaging with other key stakeholders as needed.
  • Collaborate with the IUCN Regional team and the one in Brazil on a periodic basis on relevant projects, communicating with members and partners in Brazil and the region.
  • Attend technical meetings with the IUCN Business & Nature team and/or the Centre for Science and Knowledge and other global technical Teams to stay abreast of new tools development relevant to the position.
  • Provide technical input to other projects, products and deliverables, including reviewing and reference.
  • Contribute to the review of communications materials and translations.

The above job description contains the main duties and responsibilities for this position. However, in a small organization such as IUCN, staff members are expected to show flexibility in their approach to work and be willing to undertake other tasks that are reasonably allocated to them, but which are not part of their regular job description. Where any task becomes a regular part of an employee’s responsibilities, the job description will be changed in consultation with the employee and the Human Resources Management Group.

Requirements

  • Master’s degree in Biodiversity, Biology, Ecology, Natural Resources Management, Environmental Policy, Sustainability Management, or another relevant field required. Strong grounding in biodiversity, conservation, sustainable development and social science concepts and theory, beyond immediate field of expertise.
  • Minimum 8‑10 years of experience, and minimum 5 required in engaging and working with the private sector on biodiversity themes, for instance as a consultant, with a preference for experience on the ground in Brazil (environmental and/or biodiversity assessments, biodiversity net gain reviews or monitoring, certifications…).
  • Technical understanding of IUCN key standards, tools and metrics (in particular IUCN Red Lists of Threatened Species and of Ecosystems, Nature‑based Solutions global standard, STAR metrics, IBAT) or other scientifically reputable equivalents. Some experience with Life Cycle Assessments would be an asset.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in developing, managing and coordinating projects, including planning, execution, monitoring & evaluation, technical and financial management and reporting.
  • Experience in supervising staff and coordinating consultants.
  • Proven ability to operationalise concepts, from idea to ground implementation and to socialise and mainstream scientific concepts and approaches in order to encourage their appropriation by non‑specialist stakeholders.
  • Experience in planning and developing messaging in terms of effective knowledge uptake, understands and can adapt to target audience.
  • Ability to take initiative, exercise good judgment, think laterally and resolve complex issues in a dynamic and changing environment.
  • Demonstrates professionalism and diplomacy in cross‑cultural communication, respects diverse perspectives, handles sensitive information appropriately, and works effectively as a team player with audiences ranging from high‑level management to community‑based teams.
  • Works effectively under pressure, demonstrating strong organizational skills to prioritize and balance operational tasks, manage multiple deadlines, optimise the use of time, people, and resources, and anticipate and address critical dependencies.
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills, with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Fluency in written and spoken Portuguese and English is required. Proficiency in written and spoken Spanish is desirable.
  • Relevant IT skills, in particular with online communication platforms for video conferencing and other collaboration;
  • Availability for some travel required in Brazil, in South America and perhaps internationally.
  • This position will be based in São Paulo, Brazil.

The minimum gross annual salary for this position is BRL 200,146. While this is an indicative amount effective as of the current date, changes may occur as per IUCN's compensation practices without prior notice. The same applies to other organisations hosted by IUCN.

title: Supervisor de Produção
description:
Em modalidade de turno: Responsável pela gestão e atividades relacionadas ao processo produtivo na planta em que atua, supervisionando todas as etapas, provendo recursos e monitorando as necessidades de manutenções, sejam preventivas ou corretivas, atendendo os requisitos de qualidade e concentrando o time em temas e rotinas de segurança. Suportar e prover recursos para a equipe de forma a garantir a eficiência da operação e o atingimento dos resultados operacionais, bem como difundir rotinas de gestão da área cascateadas ao nível de turno como Manutenção Autônoma, requisitos do AMPS (Ardagh Metal Production System) e demais requisitos e acordos repassados pela gerência imediata ou corporação.

Em modalidade administrativa: Responsável pela gestão e atividades da área produtiva, supervisionando processos, rotinas e cumprimentos de padrões, servindo de ponto focal e de apoio ao gerente de produção na propagação de conhecimentos, recursos, desenvolvimentos e monitoramentos necessários para execução das rotinas da área. Suporta também o Gerente de Produção em rotinas administrativas da área como reuniões de planejamentos, demandas corporativas, estratégias de melhoria de resultados e sistema de gestão (AMPS).

Em modalidade de turno:

  • Conhecer, proceder e assegurar que as Políticas da Empresa, no que diz respeito a preservação do meio ambiente, prevenção na gestão de riscos e normas de saúde e segurança do trabalho; qualidade do produto; segurança de alimentos (FSSC 22.000); código de ética; compliance; recursos humanos; missão, visão e valores da empresa, buscando o alinhamento da conduta à estratégia/objetivos estabelecidos da Empresa e garantir que sejam cumpridos pela equipe.
  • Atuar conforme os procedimentos vigentes relacionados a gestão de mudança sendo responsável pelo reporte, divulgação, plano de ação e comunicação junto a equipe.
  • Supervisionar e prover recursos para a execução das rotinas da operação, por meio do monitoramento das manutenções preventivas e corretivas dos equipamentos, controle do volume de produção e tipo de rótulo a ser produzido.
  • Realizar a abertura e fechamento das Ordens de Produção, de Manutenção e consumos de materiais necessários para organização das rotinas produtivas.
  • Tomar decisões relacionadas ao processo produtivo, baseadas em análise de dados técnicos e estatísticos para garantir a assertividade da decisão.
  • Direcionar as ações para minimizar as perdas no processo produtivo, aumentar a eficiência operacional e controlar o consumo de insumos.
  • Garantir a execução dos planos de ação e diretrizes da área na busca do atingimento das metas e resultados operacionais.
  • Supervisionar as atividades de retrabalho de produtos fora de especificação de modo adequá-los ao padrão de qualidade, bem como em processos de repacking.
  • Facilitar a comunicação e disseminação das informações corporativas entre a equipe.
  • Desenvolver tecnicamente a equipe de acordo com a matriz de competência avaliando as necessidades individuais de treinamento e atendendo aos prazos definidos pela corporação.
  • Realizar a avaliação de desempenho da equipe, dentro dos prazos estabelecidos, mapeamento as forças e oportunidades de cada colaborador para elaboração do plano de desenvolvimento individual e retenção de talentos.
  • Realizar feedbacks, promovendo o desenvolvimento de cada colaborador em alinhamento às estratégias e valores da empresa.
  • Executar atividades técnicas e administrativas ligadas a gestão de pessoas, tais como: recrutamento e seleção, integração de novos colaboradores, plano e controle de execução dos treinamentos, ajuste do ponto eletrônico, planejamento de férias, medidas disciplinares e desligamento.
  • Promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável para o engajamento da equipe e melhores resultados.
  • Praticar o conceito de “Melhoria Contínua” no processo, implementando melhorias de segurança e qualidade, cumprindo e fazendo cumprir as práticas de housekeeping.
  • Atuar no AMPS (Ardagh Metal Production System) liderando equipes e grupos internos em todas as iniciativas necessárias conformes demandas da gerência imediata ou corporativa.
  • Comunicar a gerência imediata qualquer problema que ocorra no processo produtivo, bem como seguir o fluxo de comunicação definido na planta para envolvimento de outras áreas, quando necessário e aplicável.
  • Comunicar, treinar, acompanhar e tratar quaisquer questões de segurança do time e da área, a fim de preservar integridade física dos colaboradores e aderência do time operacional à cultura e iniciativas na área de EHS.
  • Disponibilizar e gerenciar recursos como gestões visuais, ferramentas e outros juntamente com o time operacional afim de garantir que se mantenha disponibilizado e em bom estado de conservação todos recursos disponibilizados para correta execução das atividades.
  • Analisar e montar plano estratégico em caso de desvios de resultados de produção, qualidade, segurança e manutenção, apresentando em reuniões solicitadas e acompanhando o ciclo para garantir correto cumprimento de ações estabelecidadas, por si ou por outros.

Em modalidade administrativa, além de saber realizar e monitorar os mencionados acima para turno, deve:

  • Monitorar o plano de produção, a fim de conciliar as demandas corporativas para atendimento ao cliente com as necessidades locais da planta, montando estratégias de atendimento por módulo e por tipos de produto.
  • Realizar gestões de rotinas, criando e acompanhando indicadores a fim de suportar a execução das rotinas operacionais pelos times operacionais de turno de maneira correta, conforme padrões estabelecidos para cada atividade.
  • Suportar o gerente de produção, por sua solicitação ou ausência, em rotinas administrativas como reuniões corporativas e locais, demandas pontuais ou rotineiras, seja nos temas de segurança, qualidade, produção, manutenção, rh, bem como qualquer outro tema definido que alinhe a área aos requisitos definidos pela organização.
  • Realizar a gestão de KPIs da área já definidos pela companhia visando atingimento de metas e resultados.
  • Ser um facilitador de informações e conhecimento na área, treinando ou suportando os supervisores de turno envolvendo a todos nos temas necessários para a área produtiva.
  • Realizar trabalhos/análises estratégicas para a área, de forma mais abrangente e sistêmica comparando ao supervisor de turno, visando melhoria de resultados e atendimento ao cliente.
  • Auxiliar o Gerente de Produção na condução da Manutenção Autônoma na área produtiva.
  • Participar da implementação de Trials da área, quando solicitado, e repassar informações e direcionamentos aos turnos.
  • Liderar projetos na área produtiva, sejam esses definidos pela gerência local ou corporativa. Ex.: Plant of the Future (PoF).
  • Garantir que as rotinas de reuniões da área produtiva ocorram com o envolvimento correto das pessoas necessárias para boa condução e atingimento dos objetivos.
Formação

Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

  • Liderança de Equipes (com experiência prévia);
  • Análise e Interpretação de Dados;
  • Conhecimento em indicadores de performance (Produção e Manutenção);
  • Conhecimento e habilidade com processos produtivos;
  • Conhecimento em auditorias e processos de certificações;
  • Habilidade de interpretação e consulta dos manuais técnicos dos equipamentos.
  • Conhecimento em processos de Estampagem / Corte e repuxo (Prensas);
  • Idioma: Inglês Intermediário ou Avançado.
Sobre a Ardagh:

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!

Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.

Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)

title: Remote AI Agent Specialist (Freelance)
description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency. At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

Mindrift is looking for passionate freelance contributors to join the Tendem project to help build the future of hybrid agents — where human expertise and AI capabilities work hand in hand. As an AI Agent Assistant, you’ll collaborate with large language models (LLMs) that handle repetitive tasks, while you bring the nuance, judgment, and creativity required to deliver high‑quality results. In this role, you won’t just review what AI produces — you’ll work alongside it, shaping and completing outputs so they are accurate, reliable, and ready for real‑world application.

Your day‑to‑day may range from fact‑checking a scientific claim to curating a dataset, conducting market research, or refining sales leads. This flexible, part‑time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with backgrounds in research, editing, analysis, or related fields who are excited by the possibilities of human‑AI collaboration. Your contributions will directly influence how AI systems learn, evolve, and support industries worldwide.

Typical tasks

  • Deliver well‑reasoned, accurate, and clearly written outputs backed by credible sources.
  • Conduct thorough web research to verify information and collect supporting evidence.
  • Collaborate with large language models (LLMs) and internal tools, using them as copilots to complete complex tasks.
  • Design and refine prompts to guide AI toward higher‑quality results.
  • Apply best practices for working with LLMs, understanding both their strengths and limitations.
  • Adapt quickly between diverse annotation, research, and analysis tasks while following detailed guidelines.

How To Get Started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you’ll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • You are currently enrolled in or have completed a Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree in any field.
  • You have professional and/or educational experience in data annotation, demonstrate a deeper‑than‑user‑level interest in AI, and possess intellectual breadth and curiosity.
  • You are skilled in web searching, fact‑checking, intent‑checking, able to work with LLMs and have great attention to detail.
  • Your level of English is upper‑intermediate (B2) or above.
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines.
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge.

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $9/hour depending on your skills, experience, location and project needs.
  • Take part in a part‑time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

Aqui no Sesc em Minas, acreditamos que a valorização das pessoas é a base para a verdadeira transformação social. Para assegurar nosso propósito, estamos em busca de profissionais que desejam contribuir para o bem-estar e a melhoria da qualidade de vida dos comerciários e da comunidade.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar como MÉDICO(A) OTORRINOLARINGOLOGISTA na nossa unidade em Belo Horizonte/MG.

  • Atendimento aos pacientes conforme disponibilidade de agenda, por meio da realização de anamnese, exames físicos e complementares para diagnosticar condições relacionadas a ouvido, nariz, garganta, laringe e estruturas relacionadas, e traçar plano terapêutico individualizado, com a identificação dos riscos e benefícios do tratamento proposto;
  • Diagnosticar e tratar doenças do ouvido, nariz, garganta, laringe e pescoço. Incluem desde infecções agudas até condições mais complexas como tumores, além de distúrbios da voz, audição e sono;
  • Orientar os pacientes sobre os fatores de risco para doenças do ouvido, nariz, garganta, laringe e pescoço, nas consultas de rotinas, fornecendo orientações sobre hábitos de vida saudáveis para prevenção de doenças;
  • Monitorar a evolução das condições do ouvido, nariz, garganta, laringe e pescoço, ajustar tratamentos, por meio do acompanhamento dos pacientes em consultas periódicas, conforme necessário para garantir a saúde do indivíduo a longo prazo;
  • Acompanhar os contratos como Fiscal ou Gestor, se indicado pela liderança, assegurando o cumprimento eficaz dos termos e condições contratuais, garantindo que ambas as partes, contratante e contratada, estejam aderentes às obrigações acordadas, além de garantir a conformidade com as regulamentações e políticas internas, inclusive no que se refere à transparência e prestação de contas, entre outras atividades.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina
  • Residência Médica em Otorrinolaringologia ou Especialização Completa em Otorrinolaringologia, com Registro de Qualificação de Especialista (RQE) em Otorrinolaringologia.
  • Ter disponibilidade para trabalhar numa carga horária de 20 horas semanais.

Realizar atendimentos pediátricos e procedimentos ambulatoriais.

  • Seguro de vida;
  • Plano de Saúde (extenso a dependentes);
  • Vale-refeição ou vale alimentação (sem suspenção no período de férias ou licença maternidade).
  • Suprev – Plano de Previdência Privada (opcional).
  • Day off: uma folga no mês do seu aniversário para você curtir o seu dia como quiser.
  • Universidade Sesc: plataforma corporativa de aprendizado contínuo com treinamentos especiais para todos os empregados.
  • Cartão Cliente Sesc: tenha acesso ao mundo de possibilidades Sesc: consultas odontológicas e médicas, cursos, oficinas, áreas de lazer, pacotes de turismo, hospedagem e muito mais. Tudo com um preço especial.
  • Bolsa estímulo educacional: reembolso de até 50% em cursos de formação, especialização e idiomas. Invista em você! (Conforme as regras de política interna).

A O SESC valoriza a diversidade em todas as formas. Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas também às pessoas com deficiência ou reabilitados pelo INSS. Team Overview

We're looking for a highly skilled and analytical CRM Data Analyst to join our team. This person will be responsible for supporting the design and execution of lifecycle journeys and communication strategies that support the growth of our business, ensuring users receive relevant, personalized, and timely communications. The person will be crucial in transforming our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) data into actionable insights, driving smarter business decisions, boosting customer engagement, and optimizing our efforts.

Role Responsibilities

This role demands a strong blend of technical data analysis expertise, an understanding of customer journeys, and the ability to translate complex data into clear, concise insights for various stakeholders.

Main Responsibilities:

- Data Extraction & Analysis: Extract, clean, transform, and analyze large datasets from our databases. Your analysis will uncover trends and KPIs related to customer behavior, sales cycles, marketing campaign effectiveness, and customer service interactions.

- Reporting & Visualization: Develop and maintain comprehensive dashboards and reports using leading business intelligence tools. These visuals will provide clear, concise, and impactful insights to leadership and other relevant departments.

- Performance Monitoring: Continuously monitor key CRM metrics and KPIs, proactively identifying areas for improvement and opportunities for growth.

- Data Quality & Integrity: Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of our CRM data through regular audits, data validation processes, and close collaboration with CRM administrators and users.

- Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with sales, marketing, customer service, and product teams to understand their data needs, offer dedicated analytical support, and translate business questions into analytical frameworks.

- Strategic Recommendations: Provide data-driven recommendations to optimize CRM processes, improve customer segmentation, personalize customer experiences, and enhance overall business performance.

Role Qualifications

Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Marketing, or a related quantitative field.

- Proven experience as a CRM Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, or a similar role with a strong focus on CRM data.

- Expert proficiency in SQL for complex data extraction and manipulation.

- Advanced skills in a business intelligence and data visualization tool such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker Studio.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable business insights.

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of effectively conveying complex technical information to non-technical stakeholders.

- Familiarity with marketing automation platforms is a plus.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple projects simultaneously.

- Intermediate to advanced English is mandatory

title: Senior System Administrator
description:
Overview

We are hiring an experienced IT System Administrator to help us scale, secure, and optimize our cloud infrastructure. This role is ideal for someone with a strong background in AWS, Terraform, and cloud automation, who also brings hands-on experience with services like Amazon FSx, Amazon WorkSpaces, and Amazon Q Business. You\'ll be a key contributor to infrastructure design, automation, monitoring, and Zero Trust security enforcement using tools like Spacelift, Zabbix, Zscaler, and Checkpoint CloudGuard.

Responsibilities, qualifications, and other details are described below.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and enhance AWS infrastructure, including core services (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC) and enterprise solutions such as Amazon FSx (Windows file storage), Amazon WorkSpaces (virtual desktops), and Amazon Q Business (AI-powered knowledge search).
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform, orchestrating deployments and policy enforcement using Spacelift or equivalent.
  • Set up and manage monitoring solutions with Zabbix to ensure infrastructure performance and reliability.
  • Implement and support Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) using Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA) for secure remote access.
  • Enforce cloud security practices through Checkpoint CloudGuard, covering workload protection and compliance.
  • Experience with managing an IDP (Okta or equivalent) users, groups logic, and application integration.
  • Collaborate with development and IT teams to manage infrastructure code via GitHub, with a focus on stability, peer review, and traceability.
  • Automate routine processes and improve system efficiency through scripting (Bash, Python, or similar).
  • Document infrastructure standards, system configurations, and operational runbooks.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing AWS infrastructure in production environments.
  • Strong expertise in Terraform, with a track record of managing infrastructure via code.
  • Experience with Spacelift or equivalent tools for Terraform deployment pipelines.
  • Operational knowledge of Amazon FSx (especially Windows File Server), Amazon WorkSpaces.
  • Familiarity with Zabbix for infrastructure monitoring.
  • Working knowledge of Zscaler (ZTNA) or equivalent and Checkpoint CloudGuard or equivalent for security and access control.
  • Working knowledge of MDM solutions for Mac and Windows (Jamf, Endpoint Central or equivalent).
  • Skilled in using GitHub for code versioning, collaboration, and review workflows.
  • Competence in scripting and automation using Bash, Python, or similar languages.

What we offer

  • Direct cooperation with the already successful, long-term, and growing project
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture
  • Truly competitive salary
  • Help and support from our caring HR team

  • Employment type: Full-time
